R565-416 / R565-417: Polycarbonate Wall Mirror
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-polycarbonate-wall-mirror-r565-416-r565-417
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/polycarbonate-mirror/
Spec sheets: R565-416 Small, R565-417 Large
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Ligature-Resistant Polycarbonate Wall Mirror – R565-416 / R565-417
Current H1: Norix Polycarbonate Wall Mirror - Models R565-416, R565-417
Subtitle: Impact-Resistant Flush-Mount Mirror in Small and Large Sizes for Behavioral Health and Correctional Facilities
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture R565-416, R565-417 Polycarbonate Wall Mirror for Prisons and Behavioral Health Facilities
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Polycarbonate Wall Mirror is a lightweight, impact-resistant mirror for behavioral health and correctional facilities, where glass is not safe. It mounts flush to the wall, which eliminates pass-throughs and tie-off points to reduce ligature risk, and it comes in small (R565-416) and large (R565-417) sizes.
Each mirror is extruded from optical quality polycarbonate made from 100% virgin Lexan resin, for a clear image with outstanding strength. A durable coating protects the mirrored second surface, so the mirror can be handled and installed without scratching. The large mirror is compatible with the Norix Arcadian Wardrobe.
Material: Polycarbonate extruded from 100% virgin Lexan resin, in an ISO 8 clean room with inline optical scanning
Mirrored Surface: Tamper-resistant second-surface mirror, protected by a durable coating against scratches
Ligature Resistant: The flush-to-wall design eliminates pass-throughs and tie-offs
Impact Resistant: Engineered for outstanding strength in high-traffic and corrections environments
Sizes: 9.5”W×11.3”H×¼”D (small) or 11.3”W×17.3”H×¼”D (large)
Weight: 1 lb (small) or 2 lbs (large)
Cleaning: Microfiber cloth with non-abrasive soap and water; do not use glass cleaner
Warranty: 1-year limited replacement warranty; does not cover damage from improper installation, maintenance, accident, or misuse
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Available Models and Options
R565-416 – Small: 9.5”W×11.3”H×¼”D, 1 lb
R565-417 – Large: 11.3”W×17.3”H×¼”D, 2 lbs; compatible with the Norix Arcadian Wardrobe
Installation and Options
Mounting Surface: Norix recommends mounting to solid concrete surfaces; for other surfaces, consult a professional installer
Screws: Do not overtighten the screws, and avoid bevel and flat head screws, which can damage the polycarbonate
Hardware: Installation hardware not included
[H2] Applications
The Norix Polycarbonate Wall Mirror gives facilities a safe alternative to glass in rooms where residents are not always supervised.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms and bathrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Inmate cells and washrooms in correctional and detention facilities
Rooms furnished with the Norix Arcadian Wardrobe, which the large mirror fits
Explore Anchortex's Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment and Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities collections for more security mirrors and facility hardware.
[H2] About Norix Security Mirrors
Norix makes security mirrors for correctional and behavioral health facilities, where a standard glass mirror is a safety risk.
The Norix mirror range includes:
Polycarbonate Wall Mirror: Lightweight, impact-resistant polycarbonate mirror in small and large sizes
Ironman Wall Mount Mirrors: One-piece #304 stainless steel with a #8 mirror finish, in small, large, and ADA sizes
DuraVision Wall Mirrors: Round and rectangle stainless steel mirrors in tamper-resistant steel frames
DuraVision Convex Mirrors: Full, half, and quarter dome mirrors that help staff see into blind spots
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
PRICES: both variants are $0.00 on the live page, with compare-at prices of $119 (R565-416) and $150 (R565-417). The Norix April 2026 price list says $140 and $175. At your usual 80% of list, the prices would be $112.00 (compare-at $140) and $140.00 (compare-at $175).
New series section: "About Norix Security Mirrors," based on the Norix mirrors category (polycarbonate, Ironman stainless steel, and DuraVision mirrors). It has no links to individual products. The polycarbonate mirror is shown in the Norix Ironman brochure, but the Norix product page does not call it Ironman, so I did not either.
Left out: Norix says the clear image helps "reduce risks of hallucinations among residents with mental disorders." I left this health claim out. Would you like it in?
Weights and sizes match the spec sheets and the worksheet (rows 178-179: 1 / 9.5 / 0.25 / 11.3 and 2 / 11.3 / 0.25 / 17.3).
Meta title: adding "at Anchortex" would make it 66 characters, so I left it off, the same as the other long part-number titles.
Images: the page has one image (both mirrors together, 443×419, no alt text). Norix has a photo of each size (600×600). Would you like me to add them as "Norix-Polycarbonate-Wall-Mirror-R565-416-Small-Angle-View.jpg" and "Norix-Polycarbonate-Wall-Mirror-R565-417-Large-Angle-View.jpg"?
Collections: the mirror is already in Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment, Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities, and Norix Furniture.
Current meta description is a general "Facility Maintenance" line, so I replaced it.
Removed: the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
